content: Self-preference bias: LLM evaluators score their own outputs higher (Panickssery et al NeurIPS 2024; arXiv 2410.21819, 2508.06709, 2509.26600). Mitigation: independent judge from a different model family, blind, deterministic. arXiv 2605.29442 (20,574 sessions): Inaccurate Self-Reporting 22.58 percent of symptoms; Instruction-Following Failure 36.49 percent of causes; Underspecified 15.36; Premature Action 11.11; Cannot Determine 26.85.
